verdict.rationale: A probe confirms RustDesk serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary and substantive capability content: features, P2P/relay behavior, Server Pro features, and plan details. An agent can be pointed at it directly. missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs (the .md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://rustdesk.com/llms.txt # RustDesk
Remote view and control, unattended access with a permanent password, file transfer in both directions, in-session text chat, and session recording.
Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
